runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_09159c1bfffeKemcHTiiumwYcf] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the **first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026**:

**Summary (7,180 blocks):**

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Total blocks | 7,180 |
| Avg arrival time | 1,710 ms |
| Min arrival time | 141 ms |
| Max arrival time | 5,249 ms |
| P50 (median) | 1,453 ms |
| P95 | 3,126 ms |
| P99 | 3,314 ms |

`first_seen_ms` is the delay in milliseconds from the slot start time to when the block was first observed by any sentry node. The full result (all 7,180 rows with `slot`, `block_root`, `slot_start_date_time`, `first_seen_ms`, `first_seen_at`) is available in the session — you can export it with:

```
panda execute --session 585dbe6c356f <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_parquet("/workspace/...")
print(df)
PY
```

Or re-run with `LIMIT` to page through specific slot ranges.
